text: Security is a crucial part of web development. One basic step is using HTTPS, which encrypts data between the user and the server. Authentication helps verify that users are who they claim to be, often through passwords or two-factor methods. Input validation is also important because it checks the data users submit and prevents harmful code from entering the system. Developers must also be aware of common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, which can seriously damage a website. By focusing on these areas, developers can build safer applications and protect both users and their personal information.
